include-before-body:
  text: |
    <script>
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
            const form = document.querySelector("form");
            const user_id = window.location.href.split('/').pop();
            let input = document.createElement("input");
            input.type = "hidden";
            input.name = "user_id";
            input.value = user_id;
            form.appendChild(input);

            const images = document.querySelectorAll("form p");
            let i = 0 ;
            for (const img of images) {
            
                const imageUrl = img.textContent.trim();
                if( imageUrl.endsWith(".png") === false) {
                    continue;
                }
                const newImg = document.createElement("img");
                newImg.src = "/images/" + imageUrl;
                newImg.alt = "Training Image";
                newImg.style.width = (i < 2) ? "400px" : "100%";
                newImg.style.margin = "0 auto";
                // class img-fluid figure-img
                newImg.classList.add("img-fluid", "figure-img");
                img.replaceWith(newImg);
                i++;
            }
        });
    </script> 
    <style>
      fieldset.form-group {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 0.5em;
      }
      fieldset.form-group p {
        grid-column: span 2;
      }
      fieldset.form-group :last-child {
        grid-column: span 2;
      }
      div.form-group {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .quarto-layout-row {
        display: flex ;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
      }
      figcaption {
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 0.8em;
      }
    </style>
